question: Does the unchanged coherent-cycle component carrier transfer to one pre-download-frozen, new-family partial-view doorframe and reject both fixed cross-scene exact-target-absent controls?

selection.positive_authority: First pre-download-frozen new family that passed the fixed partial-view source gate; select its unique admitted reference and query views before RGB/model access.

evaluation.negative_authority: Both control queries come from a different physical 3RScan reference family and cannot contain exact target PV28.

forbidden_after_freeze: change family, target, reference/query frame, controls, models, carrier or gates
inspect RGB or model outcomes before the cohort is frozen
retry, replace or remove a failed pair
claim same-provider narrow confirmation as portal, navigation, benefit or safety evidence
claim_boundary: This freezes one new physical target and scan family selected before download, RGB and model access, plus two fixed target-absent controls. A success would be narrow same-provider partial-view carrier confirmation, not arbitrary sibling rejection, provider independence, raw-camera binding, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, deployment, benefit, reliability or safety.
